correctness.rationale: All 2640 regular seven-vertex labeled tournaments are enumerated and partitioned into three permutation orbits. Independent face-generation methods agree. Complete acyclic Morse matchings yield signed integral boundary matrices, which the standalone checker regenerates and compares entrywise to a stored full certificate. Exact Smith forms have only unit nonzero factors; independent original-complex mod-two rank computations and Hamiltonian-cycle counts confirm the Betti ranks. This establishes finite integral homology, not homotopy equivalence.

value.rationale: Every regular seven-vertex tournament belongs to one of exactly three natural isomorphism classes. Completing the exact integral multipath-homology census for all three, with the two new triples (13,43,17) and (12,44,15), is a natural finite classification and shows integral homology distinguishes all three classes although the face counts through dimension four coincide. This is a motivated topological invariant rather than an arbitrary finite mask slice.
